notes.title: Filthium Zero Playtest update v0.1.5
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,

[b]Filthium Zero Playtest v0.1.5 is here![/b] This is a bigger update and focuses on more freedom of movement, improved game feel, better visual clarity, and a couple of new features.

This is a big stepping stone on my way to the first public demo which is coming very soon! Any new feedback for the playtest would be incredibly helpful, as the goal is to give the demo as much polish as possible.

The current playtest is public so if you'd like to play, simply click "Request Access" and you'll be able to download the game instantly.

Here's the full list of changes:

[b]New features, gameplay changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Filthium Collectors: the game starts with 0 collectors on the map. Each time you fill up the barrel, a collector will be sent in from the sky.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Endgame boss: After 100% zone purge or 10 minutes survival, a final boss will spawn. Game ends only after defeating it.[/p][/*][*][p]“Select Zone” is now replaced by a “Prepare” screen, where the player selects the zone and builds their loadout (class, main weapon, ultimate, perk) - all in one place;[/p][/*][*][p]Perks. Special modifications that add extra gameplay mechanics. Perks are equipped pre-game. Only one perk can be equipped at a time. (Future idea is that new perks could be discovered in the game world, or unlocked by achieving Filthium Extraction milestones)[/p][/*][*][p]Dash / Slam cooldown is reset every time the player steps on a slime;[/p][/*][*][p]Dash cooldown is reduced to 1 second;[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up barrel is now instant;[/p][/*][*][p]Pushback is reworked into Air Boost - works both as a small jump (upgradable) from the ground or air boost in the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Chaining slime jumps[b] [/b]increases height with every jump, with max height after 5 jumps[/p][/*][*][p]Environment kills are simplified into Kill Combos, any kill counts toward the multiplier.[/p][/*][*][p]Various changes to balance, upgrade values.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Abilities, upgrades, combat:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultimate. Powerful abilities that can be used when charged to 100%. Charging progress is gained through various actions, such as extracting and depositing Filthium, performing slime jumps, airtime, kills; (Future idea is that new ults could be discovered in the game world, or unlocked by achieving Filthium Extraction milestones)[/p][/*][*][p]New auto-ability: EMP Totem;[/p][/*][*][p]Spider Mine reworked into a simpler Land Mine;[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Rocket Launcher ability;[/p][/*][*][p]Enhancements are now Mods, with multiple new Mod upgrades available;[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]UI / UX:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Visual update of HUD for better clarity and less obtrusion;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a simple damage meter to pause menu (excluding Ultimate damage for now) and recap screen[/p][/*][*][p]Jump meter added to HUD, which measures current height, airtime and slime jumps in a row;[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: instead of showing ranks with numbers, now they show up as boxes for better visibility;[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: items fade out if resources are insufficient for purchase;[/p][/*][*][p]Re-organized Pause menu to show perks, ultimate, and fit more upgrades;[/p][/*][*][p]In recap screen, added a text to remind about shop;[/p][/*][*][p]Various additional visual changes and improvements;[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to mouse & keyboard controls (still some work to be done);[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade Reroll button that works for mouse.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resolved issue where enemies would get stuck in walls (on rare occasions some still get stuck, will improve)[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue where boss wouldn’t spawn.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Misc:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changes in total score calculation;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased prices in shop;[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced currency earnings;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Filthium Vein and drop amounts.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Filthium Zero Playtest update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hi all,

[b]Filthium Zero Playtest v0.1.1 is now live on Steam![/b] The update includes fixes and changes based on your feedback, plus some new stuff. Some things are still in the works for the next update.

Huge thanks to everyone who participated and provided feedback! 🙏 

[b]List of fixes / changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added barrel fill level to HUD;,
[*] Performing Slam gives brief invincibility, so the player can’t be damaged when slamming into explosive stuff;,
[*] Added mini-cooldowns for active abilities (dash & pushback) under health bar;,
[*] Shop item information will be updated on hover when using a mouse;,
[*] Added a small pushback on level-up, also a new level-up effect;,
[*] Player will now be pushed off from Collectors after landing on them;,
[*] Fixed an issue where leveling up multiple times quickly would only give 1 upgrade;,
[*] Fixed an issue where player would get stuck inside a Collector after a slam;,
[*] Fixed an issue where the current player level in pause menu wasn’t updating;,
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would glitch when loading level;,
[*] Fixed an issue where barrel capacity number would not update in the popup;,
[*] Fixed an issue where car still intercepted projectiles even after being destroyed;,
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse cursor would be be placed in the corner in Level Up screen;,
[*] Barrel can now be instantly deployed after being picked up, without cooldown;,
[*] Added backward navigation with Escape key;,
[*] Removed possibility to jump out of map;,
[*] Moved XP bar to the top of screen;,
[*] Pause menu quit popup replaced with a basic one;,
[*] Added new game executable icon;,
[*] Minor changes in level-up stat upgrades;,
[*] Other minor visual improvements / changes.
[/list]

Some experimental additions:
[list]
[*] Slime jumps are now counted and rewards score points;,
[*] Time spent in the air is now measured and rewards score points;,
[*] Additional game stats shown in pause menu.
[/list]

Going forward, the main goal is reaching an official Demo version within the next 2 months. There will be a few more Playtest updates along the way as I work toward that. Thanks again to everyone who's participating and wishlisting!
